modules.module_title: Understand the Provisions of Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CMYUVA), UP for Entrepreneurship

pcs.pc_description: trace the concept and historical evolution of entrepreneurship
identify key characteristics and traits of successful entrepreneurs
apply effective negotiation and liaisoning techniques in business situations
use decision-making and problem-solving strategies in entrepreneurial contexts
follow time management techniques to improve productivity and efficiency
coordinate with team members and demonstrate leadership skills
maintain consistent motivation and self- discipline in business scenarios

modules.module_title: Generate Business Ideas and Recognize Opportunities

pcs.pc_description: access, identify and select business ideas aligned with market demands and emerging trends
identify and analyze internal and external sources of entrepreneurial opportunities
use a range of business development resources to support idea generation and growth
outline the key stages in product planning and development processes
read and interpret customer needs using structured market research methods
prepare a basic business model using the Business Model Canvas framework

modules.module_title: Identify Suitable Business Types and Ensure Legal Compliance

pcs.pc_description: select and read a business activity based on personal interest market feasibility and demand analysis
choose an appropriate legal business structure such as proprietorship partnership or company
follow the required steps to register the business with relevant government authorities
apply for and obtain necessary operational licenses and permits
comply with labour laws employment guidelines and statutory regulations
register the business brand and protect intellectual property through legal means
check and confirm all required approvals for business premises or location are in place

modules.module_title: Apply Pricing, Costing, and Budgeting Techniques

pcs.pc_description: calculate cost and set appropriate pricing strategies for products or services
identify the purpose and types of budgets used in business
record financial transactions using basic accounting practices
prepare and maintain statutory business accounts and financial records
apply cost estimation and control techniques in budgeting activities

modules.module_title: Use Marketing, Digital Tools, and E-Commerce Platforms

pcs.pc_description: apply a mix of traditional and digital marketing techniques to promote the business
identify types of digital marketing and match them to business objectives
create and manage content for a business website or online platform
operate and manage sales using various e- commerce platforms
plan and execute promotional campaigns and advertising strategies
access digital payment systems in a secure and efficient manner
access and interpret key GST provisions and registration steps
identify key income tax concepts applicable to MSMEs
follow compliance steps for timely income tax submission
apply rules related to MSME delayed payment grievance redressal

modules.module_title: Demonstrate Basic Banking and Financial Literacy

pcs.pc_description: identify suitable types of bank accounts for business use
conduct safe and secure digital transactions through banking platforms
access various types of credit and loan facilities for entrepreneurs
follow steps to maintain a strong business credit profile

modules.module_title: Plan for Business Expansion and Long-Term Sustainability

pcs.pc_description: assess different strategies for business expansion
assess the growth potential and scalability of a business model
identify new market opportunities for business diversification
plan and strategize funding approaches for business scaling
select a business model based on market research and self-assessment
conduct a feasibility study for the chosen business idea
assess, prepare a detailed project report and execution plan
simulate implementation through role play case study or practical exercise
present business project findings and solutions to peers or experts
revise and refine the business plan based on received feedback
